metadata.model_name: FloodSense Chennai Ward Vulnerability Heuristic Model (v2.0-Alpha)
metadata.status: EXPERIMENTAL INDICATOR — NOT AN OFFICIAL FLOOD FORECAST
metadata.disclaimer: This score is a transparent rule-based heuristic designed for situational awareness during heavy rainfall. It combines published historical waterlogging frequency, low-lying elevation traits, and drainage basin capacity. It does NOT guarantee water levels or replace official IMD/CWC warnings.
metadata.formula_description: Composite Risk Score (0 - 100) = (Historical Vulnerability Weight * 40%) + (Elevation Depression Factor * 30%) + (Drainage Basin Bottleneck Factor * 30%). Rainfall intensity multiplier scales the baseline risk.
official_references: Greater Chennai Corporation Comprehensive Stormwater Drainage Master Plan
Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority Vulnerability Atlas
Central Water Commission (CWC) Chennai Basins Historical Flood Levels

zones.elevation_trait: Low-lying marshland edge / flat basin (< 5m MSL)
zones.recommended_action: Avoid parking vehicles in basements during Orange/Red alerts. Move essentials above ground level.
Monitor municipal motor pump advisories. Secure power inverters and ground floor appliances.
Stay clear of open drains and underpasses during intense cloud bursts.

zones.drainage_outlet: Mambalam Canal (Prone to trash choke points)
zones.recommended_action: Subway closures frequent; use elevated flyovers.
Watch for sea-surge high tide warnings that delay canal drainage.
Arterial roads generally clear except for underpass sumps.

zones.drainage_outlet: Direct SWD to sea / Buckingham Canal
zones.recommended_action: Rapid drainage along primary SWD channels.

zones.elevation_trait: Moderate-high (10-15m MSL with St. Thomas Mount ridge)
zones.recommended_action: High ground; watch for localized runoff from hill slopes.
